srum_logs.label: SRUM (ESE logs)
srum_logs.justification: ESE side files, used for SRUDB.dat consistency

reg_system.label: SYSTEM hive
reg_system.how: RECmd --bn Kroll_Batch.reb then --bn pipeline\config\recmd\Sleuthline_Complement.reb (job recmd_complement: EMDMgmt, Active Setup, Print Monitors/Processors, BootExecute/SetupExecute/Execute, PCA Store/Persisted)

reg_software.label: SOFTWARE hive
reg_software.how: RECmd --bn Kroll_Batch.reb then --bn pipeline\config\recmd\Sleuthline_Complement.reb (job recmd_complement: EMDMgmt, Active Setup, Print Monitors/Processors, BootExecute/SetupExecute/Execute, PCA Store/Persisted)

reg_ntuser.label: NTUSER.DAT
reg_ntuser.how: RECmd --bn Kroll_Batch.reb then --bn pipeline\config\recmd\Sleuthline_Complement.reb (job recmd_complement: EMDMgmt, Active Setup, Print Monitors/Processors, BootExecute/SetupExecute/Execute, PCA Store/Persisted)

reg_usrclass.label: UsrClass.dat (ShellBags)
reg_usrclass.how: RECmd --bn Kroll; SBECmd -d <Users> WITHOUT --nl (otherwise the transaction logs are ignored)

reg_txlogs.label: Registry transaction logs
reg_txlogs.justification: Replayed by RECmd for dirty hives

recyclebin_r.label: Recycle Bin ($R, deleted content)
recyclebin_r.justification: RBCmd handles the $I files; Dissect links $I and $R.

timeline.label: Windows Timeline (ActivitiesCache.db)
timeline.how: Working copy (database + -wal/-shm) then WxTCmd -f <copy>; output stored under the original path (parsed\wxtcmd\C\Users\<u>\AppData\Local\ConnectedDevicesPlatform\<account>\) to cite the evidence
timeline.justification: WxTCmd does not write the source database in its CSV: the original path is rebuilt from the output folder (normalize_map.json, wxt_activity.evidence). Fixed on 2026-10-18.

search_index.label: Windows Search index
search_index.how: Working copy (database + logs) then esentutl /r on the copy, then sidr -f csv; in addition target-query -f search
search_index.justification: ESE database copied live = dirty state (+ corrupted page on test02): SIDR fails with code 0. Log replay on a copy (built-in Windows tool); Dissect reads the index through another ESE implementation.

ps_history.label: PowerShell history (PSReadLine)
ps_history.justification: Adds the user and the file timestamp.

webcache.label: WebCache (IE / legacy Edge, ESE)
webcache.justification: Dissect reads the KAPE output directly and produces exportable records; checked in the source code.

edge_legacy.label: Legacy Edge (UWP): cache and data
edge_legacy.justification: Raw cache files; history is in WebCacheV01.dat

sched_tasks.label: Scheduled tasks (XML)
sched_tasks.justification: Maintained plugin, same framework as the other artifacts without a dedicated parser.

wmi_repo.label: WMI repository (OBJECTS.DATA)
wmi_repo.how: target-query -f cim.consumerbindings (ActiveScript / CommandLine consumers and their bindings)
wmi_repo.justification: Avoids a home-made Python 3 port of PyWMIPersistenceFinder (POLICY_parsers.md rule); maintained plugin.

startup.label: Startup folders
startup.how: "native" job of orchestrator.py: one record per file (original CopyLog timestamps, SHA-256) -> native/startup.jsonl
startup.justification: No format to decode: list of files.

rdp_cache.label: RDP bitmap cache
rdp_cache.justification: Only present if the host opened outbound RDP sessions

defender.label: Windows Defender logs
defender.justification: Covers MPLog, MpCmdRun, quarantine and exclusions in a single tool. KNOWN LIMITATION (Dissect 3.25.1): defender.mpcmdrun fails on localized dates (e.g. "dim. oct. 18 2026", French Windows). Same information available in the Defender EVTX (Hayabusa / EvtxECmd). To be reported upstream (fox-it/dissect.target); no home-made parser.

onedrive.label: OneDrive (ODL logs and settings)
onedrive.how: odl.py -o <csv> <logs folder> (ObfuscationStringMap / general.keystore taken into account)
onedrive.justification: Reference tool by the author of the research on the ODL format; handles the encryption of recent versions. COLLECTION LIMITATION: without general.keystore (recent OneDrive) or ObfuscationStringMap.txt, strings stay encrypted; check that the KAPE target collects the complete settings\\<account> folder.

dpapi.label: DPAPI master keys
dpapi.justification: Needed to decrypt user secrets; not parsed

etw.label: ETW traces / diagnostics (.etl, WDI)
etw.justification: SleepStudy, WDI, DeliveryOptimization, WMI autologgers: specialized ETW parsing not planned

hosts.label: hosts file
hosts.how: "native" job of orchestrator.py: active entries of the file -> native/hosts.jsonl

remote_access.label: Remote access tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Splashtop, RustDesk)
alternatives: manual reading of the text logs (ad.trace, connection_trace.txt, Connections_incoming.txt)
remote_access.justification: Existing Dissect plugins: no home-made parser (POLICY_parsers.md).

remote_access_other.label: Other remote access tools / RMM (ScreenConnect, Atera, Kaseya...)
remote_access_other.how: no dedicated parser: presence reported by the inventory; activity through EVTX (Application log, ScreenConnect source), $MFT, Prefetch, services
remote_access_other.justification: Proprietary text logs without a recognized tool: read the raw files; to be re-evaluated according to POLICY_parsers.md.

rdp_files.label: RDP connection files (.rdp, Default.rdp)
rdp_files.how: "native" job: key:type:value settings of each .rdp (UTF-16), passwords excluded -> native/rdp_files.jsonl
alternatives: plaso winreg/mstsc_rdp and mstsc_rdp_mru (registry only, not the .rdp files)
rdp_files.justification: No recognized parser of the .rdp files themselves ("key:type:value" text); trivial reading. The "password 51:b" field (DPAPI-encrypted) is never extracted. Complements mru.mstsc / Terminal Server Client.

notepad_tabs.label: Windows 11 Notepad tabs (TabState)
notepad_tabs.justification: Dissect plugin already installed (checked in plugins.txt and the source code): content of saved and unsaved tabs, deleted content when available. Timestamp only for saved tabs.

panther.label: Windows setup logs (Panther)
panther.how: "native" job: one timestamped line = one record (local date, level, component, message) -> native/panther.jsonl
panther.justification: No recognized parser of setupact.log / setuperr.log in plaso, Dissect or EZTools. Line-by-line text format: trivial reading. Times in the machine's local time (converted to UTC during normalization).

panther_other.label: Panther (other files)
panther_other.justification: unattend.xml may contain setup passwords (in clear text or base64): not parsed, like the other secrets (DPAPI, LSA). Presence reported by the inventory; file available in the collection.

wifi_profiles.label: Wi-Fi profiles (Wlansvc)
wifi_profiles.how: "native" job: WLANProfile v1 XML (name, SSID, connection type/mode, authentication, encryption) + CopyLog timestamps -> native/wifi_profiles.jsonl
alternatives: RECmd/Kroll KnownNetworks and Dissect network_history (NetworkList registry: first/last connection)
netsh wlan show profiles (live system only)
wifi_profiles.justification: No Dissect plugin nor plaso parser for the Wlansvc XML files; XML documented by Microsoft, read with the standard library. keyMaterial / sharedKey (DPAPI-encrypted key) never extracted. Connection dates remain in KnownNetworks / network_history.

onedrive_db.label: OneDrive (SyncEngineDatabase.db)
onedrive_db.how: no parser installed: the database is copied by the sqlecmd job, but SQLECmd has no map for it
alternatives: OneDriveExplorer (Beercow, MIT license, CLI: OneDriveExplorer.exe -s, CSV / JSON / HTML output)
SQLECmd map to create (no OneDrive map in SQLECmd/SQLMap/Maps as of 2026-10-18)
onedrive_db.justification: TEMPORARILY RULED OUT, pending validation: OneDriveExplorer is the reference tool (reads SyncEngineDatabase.db with -s) but is not installed; POLICY_parsers.md forbids installing it without the analyst's validation (addition to 02_Install-Tools.ps1 with a lock entry). No home-made parser since a tool exists. Meanwhile: ODL logs (odl.py), $MFT / $J of the OneDrive folder, raw database in the collection. The inventory reports the database (NOT COVERED, gaps.json).

registry_keys._doc: Registry keys added or checked outside the file catalog (the hives are in "artifacts"). Batch: pipeline\config\recmd\Sleuthline_Complement.reb (job recmd_complement).

emdmgmt.justification: Missing from Kroll_Batch.reb 1.22 and from the example batches; volume serial number (decimal) in the subkey name. Missing on systems without ReadyBoost (SSD), like test01.

active_setup.justification: Missing from Kroll; definition taken from SoftwareASEPs.reb (the full batch would add noise).

print_monitors.justification: Missing from Kroll; definition taken from SystemASEPs.reb.

bootexecute.justification: Missing from Kroll; definition taken from SystemASEPs.reb.

pca_store.justification: Missing from Kroll; definition taken from AllRegExecutablesFoundOrRun.reb. The Windows 11 PCA files (appcompat\pca) are still handled by plaso (pca artifact).

usb_properties.how: already covered: RECmd USB, USBSTOR and SCSI plugins called by Kroll_Batch.reb (FirstInstalled, LastConnected, LastRemoved columns)
usb_properties.justification: No additional entry: the plugins already decode these properties (checked on test01: recmd_kroll_C_USB.csv and _SCSI.csv). Normalization mapping added for USBSTOR (reg_usbstor).
